US Supreme Court lifts limits on coordinated political party spending

The US Supreme Court has struck down federal limits on campaign spending by political parties when coordinated with candidates. This decision stems from a 2022 lawsuit challenging the Federal Election Commission's enforcement of such limits. The ruling effectively removes a significant barrier to wealthy donors contributing unlimited funds to federal campaigns.
